title: Beetroot and Indian Spiced Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry made with beetroot, Indian spices, and silky textures. Perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Add the sliced beetroot and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the soy sauce and curry powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
Cook time may vary depending on the size and tenderness of the beetroot.
Garnish with sliced green onions for added flavor and color.
